text:
I can't confirm that no burning occurred, but the evidence shows no satellite-detected fire.

NASA FIRMS recorded zero thermal detections intersecting the property between 2026-10-04 and 2026-11-03. All four sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21 and MODIS) covered every day of that period, so the lack of detections isn't a data gap.

However, this doesn't prove that no fire occurred. Small, short-lived, cool or cloud-obscured fires may go undetected. The evidence also says nothing about burned area, the cause of any land change (harvest, fire, storm or clearing), or anything outside this period.

A safe wording is: "No FIRMS thermal anomalies were detected on the property from 4 October to 3 November 2026." If you need stronger assurance, you'd need burned-area imagery or ground confirmation.
